parole.significato: A terrestrial bird of the genus Coua, in the cuckoo family.

parole.significato: Any of several diverse small mammals, of the family Tenrecidae, many native to Madagascar.
parole.testo: From French tanrec, from Malagasy tàndraka or trandraka related to Malay landak (“porcupine”); English from 18th century.
